How to Book Your Studio

A quick walkthrough for booking your time at The Vintage Loft — on your phone or computer, in just a few minutes.

Questions any time? Call or text us at 905-767-2099.
1

Pick your date & time

Open our booking page. Choose your date, a start time and an end time (1‑hour minimum, half‑hour steps), then tap Search. We’ll show every studio that’s free in that window. In this example we’re booking 10:00–11:00.
Already know which studio you want? Scroll down to Already know your Studio? to jump straight to its calendar.
2

Choose your studio

You’ll see each open studio with its hourly rate and the price for your length. Tap Select on the one you’d like — here we’re choosing The Gatsby.
3

Add your extras

Add any rentals or services — a seamless backdrop, a dress rental, studio lighting, and more. Tap + to add something, − to remove it.
4

Browse & screenshot what you like

On an add-on like the Seamless backdrop, tap “Click here to see our backdrops” to open our page. When you find one you love, take a screenshot of it on your phone — you’ll upload it in a moment so we set up exactly that look.
This works for the dress rental and the cake smash options too. Tap the link, screenshot your favourite, and upload it in the next steps.
5

Want a second studio? Add another one

Booking more than one room? Tap “＋ Add another studio” in your Booking summary (you’ll also see it when you review your order) and book a second one at another time. Here we add the Grand Room for 11:00–12:00 right after the Gatsby. Both studios go on one booking with one confirmation.
6

Tell us about your visit

Add your name and email, then check what best describes your booking so we can prep the studio for you.
7

Upload your inspiration pics

Tap “＋ Add photos” and upload the screenshots you took — your backdrop, a dress, any inspo. You can add more than one. This is exactly how we know what you pictured.
That’s the backdrop screenshot from step 4 — yours would be whatever you screenshotted from our page.
8

Have a code or a gift card?

Pop a discount or promo code in the first box, and a gift card in the second. You can use both at once — the discount comes off first, then your gift card covers the rest.
9

Review your total & pay

Both studios show on one order. Check your total, enter your card, and confirm — you’re paying in full to hold your time.
10

You’re booked!

One confirmation number covers both studios, and a receipt lands in your inbox right away. Give the quick rental contract a read and sign, and you’re all set. See you soon!
11

Create an account (optional, but handy)

Tap My Account → Create account and sign up with your email and a password. Your account keeps all your bookings — and any credit — in one place, so you can manage things yourself any time.
12

See your bookings & credit

Your account shows every upcoming booking, your account credit, and a receipt link for each. Both studios from our example are right there.
13

Change a booking

Tap Edit booking to change the studio, date, or time. If the new time costs the same, there’s nothing more to pay; if it’s a bit more, you just pay the difference; if it’s less, the extra stays as credit.
14

Cancel a booking → it becomes credit

Changed your plans? Tap Cancel. As long as you’re 48 hours or more before your start time (7 days on holiday weekends), your payment turns into account credit to use whenever you rebook — see the credit jump right into the account here.
